design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (difficulty edu_enrollment_payments_and_changes, M=2).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}; edu_ext_amended_entitlement_restoration takes 6 factors, edu_ext_post911_election_entitlement takes 4.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: edu_ext_verified_rate_of_pursuit, edu_ext_flat_monthly_release, tools verify_enrollment_month_96d675a6 and release_monthly_benefit_payment_750f9b6a. Claimed here: edu_ext_amended_entitlement_restoration (agent tool restore_amended_entitlement_47573840, edu_entitlement_restored) and edu_ext_post911_election_entitlement (user tool elect_post911_in_place_of_chapter_2e090e13, edu_benefit_relinquished). This is the last task: the four extended policies are now covered once each and no policy or tool is left idle.
[Why a good test] The caller only asks to switch to the Post-9/11 GI Bill. The election credits Post-9/11 entitlement from the Chapter 30 ledger, and its rule says the figure is not fixed until every amended certification whose dropped days were charged carries a restoration entry. The ledger shows the Spring 2026 reduction (8 -> 5 credits, last date of attendance 2026-02-17) with its 63-day charge and no restoration, so the agent must first work out and post the restoration (12-week session measured on 9 credits, charges by measured training time, the one-time exclusion of the first credits dropped, waiver credit read from the debt records), then hand the election over with the carried days (ledger after the restoration, the Spring 2027 charge released because that term has not begun, the unpaid debt balance held back at the rate her payments averaged).
[Problem-tree card] root edu_ext_post911_election_entitlement; edge edu_ext_post911_election_entitlement <- edu_ext_amended_entitlement_restoration: kind value_input, gate ch30_days_left, form state, policy_source 'The Post-9/11 entitlement credited on an election is not fixed until the relinquished chapter's entitlement ledger carries a restoration entry for every amended certification whose dropped days were charged.' (negated direction, 'not ... until'), condition 'The relinquished chapter's entitlement ledger carries an edu_entitlement_restored entry for the reduced certification behind every amendment whose dropped days had been charged.', resolved_by restore_amended_entitlement_47573840 (owner agent). Four-point test: ordering connective 'not fixed until'; waits on a record-visible state (a restoration entry on the ledger); no tool, id or code token; scope 'every amended certification whose dropped days were charged'. Only restore_amended_entitlement_47573840 creates restoration entries in this difficulty. Opening evidence: edu_enrollments.98635a7d-d64f-46c6-b9f6-5246f8406dd2.amendment_reason = reduction, edu_entitlement_ledger.76755495-ebab-46e3-9adb-a098eaa1f685.days = 63, no edu_entitlement_restored row, cached remaining 445. Order [edu_ext_amended_entitlement_restoration, edu_ext_post911_election_entitlement]. Deletion sensitivity: skipping the restoration gives 554 instead of 563. The persona never mentions entitlement, restorations or the debt unless asked; tools check nothing.
[Base-invariant card] restore_amended_entitlement_47573840: edu_evt_enrollment_change and edu_entitlement_charging govern edu_entitlement_restored; neither has a gate on that event (charge_active applies only to charges), so both are policy_scope, satisfied by the amendment and the charge rows. elect_post911_in_place_of_chapter_2e090e13: edu_excl_chapter_election governs edu_benefit_relinquished, no gate; Chapter 30 is relinquishable and active. Overwrites declared: edu_evt_enrollment_change 'Entitlement charged for days no longer certified is restored' -> forgiven overpayment days stay charged; edu_excl_chapter_election 'receives Post-9/11 entitlement equal to the Chapter 30 months remaining at the election' -> carried days plus released term less held-back days.
[Business-object card] Target: Spring 2026 certification 2f8040d1-c609-46f4-a491-76374b04b6bb (MSU Denver, 2026-01-20..2026-04-13, 8 credits) and its reduction 98635a7d-d64f-46c6-b9f6-5246f8406dd2; its charge 76755495-ebab-46e3-9adb-a098eaa1f685 63 days; the education debt 92fbc53e-1bad-4d70-90ad-246b0178c63a whose source record is 98635a7d-d64f-46c6-b9f6-5246f8406dd2 (original 902.28, waiver credit 300.00, three 100.00 payments, balance 302.28, plan). Excluded: the 2017-2019 certifications and charges (ended, unamended; they enter only the ledger totals), Spring 2027 5ba83c44-74c1-4353-bce3-17e1b6875092 (released on the election, never restored).
[Factor card edu_ext_amended_entitlement_restoration] restoration_start_point tier 2 (no mitigating on evidence, split at LDA) -> 13.75 raw (baseline whole term -> 16); restoration_exclusion_left the 3 dropped credits up to the one-time 6-credit exclusion, all 3 excused (baseline none -> 16); restored_term_measure 9 (baseline 12 -> 7); certified_daily_charge 0.75 (baseline 1 -> 21, because at 1 a day the 63 charged days would cover only 63 term days); remaining_daily_charge 0.5 (baseline day for day 1 -> 0); forgiven_overpayment 300.00 (cross-difficulty debt, multi-source; baseline 0 -> 14); whole baseline (day for day on both sides) 0. Near-miss: the school's stamps half_time (certification) and less_than_half_time (amendment, 42 percent on the 12-credit standard) disagree with the measured three-quarter and half charges; the 300.00 of plan payments are not forgiveness.
[Factor card edu_ext_post911_election_entitlement] carried_chapter_days 454 (baseline full grant -> 1080); certified_term_release 116 (baseline 0 -> 447); unpaid_overpayment_holdback 302.28 (cross-difficulty debt; baseline 0 -> 570); holdback_conversion_rate 1259.00 from a paid monthly rate of 1791.08 (baseline 2518.00 -> 566); whole baseline 1080. Near-miss: the cached entitlement_days_remaining 445 is stale unless the restoration is posted; the original debt amount 902.28 applies only to a debt on hold.
[Seed design] Renata L. Castillo (phone 7205550152, SSN4 3862, file 337205914, DOB 1988-11-23), Navy 2013-06-01..2017-05-31 (48 months -> 100 percent level). Debt rules checked: waiver requested 14 days after notice (within 180 and the 30-day hold window), partially granted for 300.00, plan of 7 months at 100.00 within 12 months without a Financial Status Report, payments on time, interest 0, no Treasury referral.
[Persona] Brisk and organized; volunteers the switch and her readiness to elect; identity, schooling, the February drop and the debt only when asked; agrees to a correction when raised; elects when handed over; ends when told it is recorded.
[Standard solution] locate -> verify -> read benefit, enrollments, ledger, payments, debt account, transactions, requests -> restore (restore_amended_entitlement_47573840: 2f8040d1-c609-46f4-a491-76374b04b6bb, amended_enrollment, 9, 2026-02-18, 2026-04-13) -> hand over the election (elect_post911_in_place_of_chapter_2e090e13: 30f4ed98-aec9-49a5-a500-89d40b3d591d, 100 percent level, 563).
[Verification run] sensitivity script on tasks/1.json: edu_ext_amended_entitlement_restoration 9, factor baselines 16/16/7/31/0/14, all-baseline 0; edu_ext_post911_election_entitlement 563, factor baselines 1080/447/570/566, all-baseline 1080; skipping step 10 gives 554. check_compute recomputes the same.
[Draft from visible context] From the KB prose, finder returns and persona the only reading is: restoration owed (state named by the election's prerequisite sentence, posted only by the restoration write) -> 9 days -> election 563 at the 100 percent level.
[Closure] policies {PC, PD} = computations = required_documents; tools [restore_amended_entitlement_47573840, elect_post911_in_place_of_chapter_2e090e13] in first-call order; difficulty union = 4 policies, 4 tools, pairwise disjoint with task 0.
[Revision round 2 - policy-task audit] D5: the restoration rule now converts the forgiven amount 'at the flat monthly rate matching the daily charge of the credits certified worked out above ... whatever training time the certification itself records', so the recorded half_time stamp can no longer give a second rate (the release policy in turn now says 'the training time recorded' for its record-based fall-through). F4: the restoration baseline now reads 'Under the standard measurement a credit load is charged day for day, 1 a day while any credits are certified, and nothing is charged once no credits remain', and remaining_daily_charge's declared baseline is the same (1 while credits remain, 0 when none) with its fall-through tier 'at least the full-time measure -> full_charge'; the whole baseline is a definite 0. F5: the reduction now leaves 5 credits: measured on the 12-week session that is half time (0.5) while the amendment's stamp (12-credit standard) says less_than_half_time, so the stamp plus the base scale (0.25) no longer gives the scored value; the debt (902.28 overpayment, 300.00 waived, 302.28 balance, 7-month plan) and the April payment (545.57 at the half-time rate) were reseeded to stay consistent. F1/O3: the exclusion ladder no longer has a second-reduction allowance (first reduction: every dropped credit up to 6, or 6; earlier reduction on file: none). Mitigating observation: the rule now speaks of mitigating circumstances accepted 'on the student's evidence', separate from the automatic exclusion, so the seeded flag false is consistent. Re-run: restoration 9 (16/16/7/31/0/14, all 0); election 563 (1080/447/570/566, all 1080); skipping the restoration gives 554.
[Revision round 3 - policy-task audit revision_2] F6: restoration_exclusion_left now sizes the once-per-student exclusion on the restored term's own measure: 3 credit hours on a 6-credit measure, 4.5 on a 9-credit measure, 6 on the full-time standard, none after an earlier reduction. These are distinct figures, no longer one treatment written as two. Here the term is measured on 9 credits -> 4.5, and 3 credits were dropped, so all 3 are excused; restoration stays 9 days and the election 563 (sensitivities unchanged: 16/16/7/31/0/14, all 0; 1080/447/570/566, all 1080; skipping the restoration gives 554).
[Revision round 4 - policy-task audit revision_3] F7 / O5: restoration_exclusion_left no longer sizes the exclusion by term length. Credits excused in a restoration are every dropped credit when mitigating circumstances were accepted on evidence; the credits dropped up to the tier's one-time mitigating_excused_credits (6 on Chapter 30) for a first reduction without evidence; none after an earlier reduction. This matches base edu_evt_enrollment_change, so there is no undeclared override. restoration_start_point now ladders on the last date of attendance (inside the term -> split at it; no reduction on file -> nothing restored; otherwise the whole term). Here 3 credits are dropped on the first reduction, all excused: restoration 9, election 563 (sensitivities 16/16/7/31/0/14, all 0; 1080/447/570/566, all 1080; skipping the restoration gives 554).
[Revision round 5 - policy-task audit revision_4] F8: restoration_start_point no longer carries the tier 'no reduction on file -> nothing restored'. That tier divided no customer who reaches a restoration write. It now ladders on a distinction VA makes, that a restoration never gives back days that were never charged:
 (1) last date of attendance inside the term and the term's charge (the charge entries for training begun in the last twelve months) covers every day of the term at the certified charge -> split at the last date of attendance, days after it to the term end;
 (2) last date of attendance inside the term but that charge ran out before the term end (entitlement exhausted mid-term) -> the days after the last date of attendance counted only up to the last day the charge covers;
 (3) otherwise (last date of attendance not inside the term, e.g. dropped before classes began) -> every day of the term (the baseline).
It stays the restoration's honest method factor. This world sits on tier 1 (63 charged / 0.75 = 84 = term days): restoration still 9, election 563. Sensitivities 16/16/7/21/0/14 (certified_daily_charge's baseline now 21: at 1 a day the 63 charged days cover only 63 term days, so tier 2 applies), all-baseline 0; election 1080/447/570/566, all 1080; skipping the restoration gives 554. Task 0 untouched.
[Revision round 6 - KB audit, policy-side items] PS-1: the restoration rule now fixes the restoration entry's period: 'The restoration entry records as its first day of training the term start when the days through the last date of attendance are restored at a difference above none, or when the last date of attendance is not inside the term, and otherwise the day after the last date of attendance; it records as its last day of training the term end, or, when the term's charge ran out before the term end, the last day that charge covers'. Here the through-difference is 0.75 - 0.75 = 0, so the period is 2026-02-18..2026-04-13 (the GT values, unchanged), and 2026-01-20 is excluded by the text. PS-0: the restoration rule now gives entitlement back only once the reduced term has ended ('while the term end carried on the amendment is today or a later day, nothing is given back yet and no restoration entry is booked'), and the compute returns 0 in that case. This term ended 2026-04-13, so the restoration is due and the scored values are unchanged: 9 days, election 563.
user_scenario: You are Renata L. Castillo, a 37-year-old Navy veteran in Denver who is going back to Metropolitan State University of Denver. You are organized and a bit brisk, you like to get things done in one call, and you speak in short, clear sentences. You open with: "I want to switch from my Montgomery GI Bill to the Post-9/11 GI Bill before my spring classes start, because I keep hearing it pays a lot more for school." You are using the Montgomery GI Bill (Chapter 30) now. You have read that the switch is permanent; you understand the switch is permanent and you are ready to make that choice yourself on this call, as long as the representative walks you through it. If the representative needs to find you, give your phone number, 7205550152. To verify your identity, give the last four of your Social Security number, 3862, your VA file number, 337205914, and your date of birth, 1988-11-23, as they ask for them. Only if asked about your schooling do you say that MSU Denver already certified your spring 2027 classes, and that last spring you dropped one three-credit class in February and kept the rest. Only if asked about debts do you say you got a letter about an education overpayment from last spring, VA forgave part of it, and you pay 100 dollars a month on the rest; you do not remember the exact balance and tell them to check the record. If asked about your service, you served in the Navy from June 2013 to May 2017 and the dates are on your DD-214. You do not know how VA counts entitlement or how many days you have left, and you never guess a number. If the representative says something on your record has to be corrected or updated first, you say that is fine and to go ahead. When the representative explains the election and hands it over to you, you make it right there; if they tell you the benefit level and the number of days of Post-9/11 entitlement you will receive and ask you to confirm, you say yes and go ahead. Once the representative tells you the switch has been recorded, you thank them, say you will tell the school certifying official, and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.enrollment_id: Value 2f8040d1-c609-46f4-a491-76374b04b6bb. Basis: the restoration tool asks for 'the reference number of the school's term certification whose charged entitlement is given back'; the reduction 98635a7d-d64f-46c6-b9f6-5246f8406dd2 names it as its source certification. Uniqueness: it is the only reduced certification; Spring 2027 and the 2017-2019 terms were never amended.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.restoration_reason: Value amended_enrollment. Basis: docstring 'amended_enrollment when the school reported a reduction or withdrawal that left days no longer certified'. Uniqueness: no closure or program disapproval is on record; not_applicable is never a restoration.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.days: Value 9 (calculated by edu_ext_amended_entitlement_restoration): 12-week session measured on 9 credits; 8 certified credits charge 0.75, 5 remaining charge 0.5 (5 of 9 is at least half; the amendment's less_than_half_time stamp is on the 12-credit standard and is not read); mitigating not accepted on evidence, first reduction ever, so the 3 dropped credits are excused up to the Chapter 30 one-time exclusion of the first 6 credit hours (all 3) and the kept 8 credits keep 0.75 through 2026-02-17; so only the 55 days after it are restored at 0.75 - 0.5 = 13.75 (the term's 63-day charge at 0.75 covers all 84 days, so the days run to the term end); waiver credit 300.00 converted at the three-quarter rate 1888.50 matching the 0.75 certified charge = 4.77 days stay charged; 8.98 rounds to 9.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.charge_period_start: Value 2026-02-18. Basis: the restoration rule 'The restoration entry records as its first day of training the term start when the days through the last date of attendance are restored at a difference above none, or when the last date of attendance is not inside the term, and otherwise the day after the last date of attendance'. Uniqueness: the last date of attendance 2026-02-17 is inside the term 2026-01-20..2026-04-13, and the days through it are restored at 0.75 - 0.75 = 0 (kept 5 + 3 excused = 8 credits, the same three-quarter charge as certified), which is not above none; so the first day is the day after the last date of attendance, 2026-02-18. The term start 2026-01-20 would apply only with a positive through-difference.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.charge_period_end: Value 2026-04-13. Basis: the same rule 'it records as its last day of training the term end, or, when the term's charge ran out before the term end, the last day that charge covers'. Uniqueness: the term's charge of 63 days at the certified 0.75 covers 84 days = every day of 2026-01-20..2026-04-13, so it did not run out early and the last day is the term end on the amendment, 2026-04-13.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.post911_entitlement_days: Value 563 (calculated by edu_ext_post911_election_entitlement): ledger 1080 granted + 9 restored - 635 charged = 454 carried; Spring 2027 not begun -> 116 released; debt in repayment plan, balance 302.28 held back at the half-time rate 1259.00 chosen by the 1791.08 paid monthly rate of the last twelve months (5015.02 for 84 days) = 7.20 days; 454 + 116 - 7.20 = 562.80 -> 563.

edges.condition: The relinquished chapter's entitlement ledger carries an edu_entitlement_restored entry for the reduced certification behind every amendment whose dropped days had been charged.
edges.policy_source: The Post-9/11 entitlement credited on an election is not fixed until the relinquished chapter's entitlement ledger carries a restoration entry for every amended certification whose dropped days were charged.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Spring 2026 certification was reduced (amendment on file) and its charge of 63 days stands, but the entitlement ledger holds no restoration entry at all.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The restoration at step 10 creates an edu_entitlement_restored entry of 9 days for the Spring 2026 certification; the days remaining on the ledger become 454 and the election carries them.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: One edge. The election reads the ledger's restorations, so electing before restoring computes 554 days instead of 563 (sensitivity run with step 10 skipped); the order is forced by the prerequisite sentence.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the restoration leaves 445 days on the ledger: the election credits 554 days instead of 563, and the restoration entry is missing from the terminal state.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to switch to the Post-9/11 GI Bill and to make the election herself; it never mentions entitlement days, restorations, the ledger or her reduction unless asked about schooling, and agrees to a correction only after the representative raises one.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: elect_post911_in_place_of_chapter_2e090e13 only reads the benefit to copy the customer and payment details, then relinquishes it and opens the Post-9/11 benefit with the days given; it never checks restorations, debts or balances and always returns status elected.

factor_trace: restoration_start_point (method): reduction 98635a7d-d64f-46c6-b9f6-5246f8406dd2 has its last date of attendance 2026-02-17 inside its term, and the term's charge (63 days, the only charge entry for training begun in the last twelve months) at the certified 0.75 covers 84 days = every day of the term -> tier 1: 29 days through 2026-02-17 at 0.75 - 0.75 (kept 5 + 3 excused = 8 credits) = 0, and 55 days after to the term end at 0.75 - 0.5 = 13.75; baseline (every day of the 84-day term at 0.75 - 0.5 = 21, less 4.77) -> 16.

restoration_exclusion_left (parameter): mitigating circumstances not accepted on evidence and the reduction is the only one reported on the benefit -> tier 2: the credits dropped up to the Chapter 30 one-time exclusion of 6 (mitigating_excused_credits) = all 3 excused; baseline nothing excused -> kept charge 0.5 -> 7.25 + 13.75 - 4.77 -> 16.

restored_term_measure (parameter): 84 days = 12 weeks -> 9 credit hours; baseline 12 makes 8 credits half time (0.5) and 5 credits less than half (0.25), and converts the waiver at the half-time rate: 55 x 0.25 - 300 x 30 / 1259 = 13.75 - 7.15 -> 7.

certified_daily_charge (parameter): 8 of 9 = 89 percent -> three-quarter 0.75 (the school's half_time stamp is not read); baseline 1 -> the 63 charged days then cover only 63 of the term's days, so the days after the last date of attendance stop at day 63 (34 days): 29 x 0.25 + 34 x 0.5 = 24.25, less 300 x 30 / 2518 = 3.57 -> 21.

remaining_daily_charge (parameter): 5 of 9 = 56 percent -> half 0.5 (the amendment's less_than_half_time stamp, on 12 credits, is not read); baseline day for day while credits remain = 1 -> 55 x (0.75 - 1) - 4.77 < 0 -> 0.

forgiven_overpayment (parameter, cross-difficulty debt, multi-source): waiver credit 300.00 posted and a waiver decision on file -> 300.00 forgiven, converted at the three-quarter rate 1888.50 matching the 0.75 certified charge: 4.77 days; baseline nothing forgiven -> 13.75 -> 14.
